_doc: Minigame presentation metadata (MinigameRegistry.registration reads this together with GAMES and the game's own class). description: one line for the title card. anims: special animations its view plays. pacing: timings it overrides (Pacing keys), never stages.

meat_grinder.description: A conveyor belt into a grinder. Walk against it, grab Teeth, dodge the presses.

floor_is_meat.description: Hop plate to plate over a pit of meat before the plates drop.

last_seat.description: Musical chairs with one chair too few. Sit when the alarm goes.

hook_line_sinker.description: Fish Teeth out of a vat. Mind the jaws, and the current.

spin_cycle.description: Keep your feet in a giant spinning drum.

better_together.description: Chained to your partner, cross the saws and the holes first.

tug_of_war.description: Pull on the beat. Drag the other pair into the pit.

the_controller.description: One of you runs the machines. The rest of you run for the exit.

last_man_breathing.description: Hold your breath when the air turns foul. Last one breathing wins.

dont_press_it.description: A bomb, a panel, and four people who have to defuse it together.

dead_weight.description: Load each plate with exactly the right number of crates.

pick_your_poison.description: Everyone picks a bottle. Everyone drinks.

run_for_your_life.description: Something's chasing you round the arena. Don't be last.

wrong_answers.description: One of you knows the answer. The others have to guess who's lying.

human_shield.description: Carry the parcel through the darts. Your partner takes the hits.

confession.description: Somebody did something. Confess, accuse, or keep quiet.

consensus.description: Pick a door. If you all agree, nobody gets hurt.

hot_potato.description: Pass the ticking thing around. Don't be holding it.

organ_trail.description: SPECIAL EVENT: surgery in pairs. One operates, one is operated on.

roulette.description: ENCOUNTER: a revolver, a cylinder, and a table of friends.
